CASES_DATA.label: HAZARD
CASES_DATA.desc: Quake hazard! Estimate the magnitude of Idaho's 1983 Borah Peak earthquake. (6.9) Miss by more than 0.5 and lose 500 pts.
CASES_DATA.fact: The Borah Peak quake was Idaho's largest recorded earthquake. It lifted Borah Peak, Idaho's tallest mountain, about a foot higher.

CASES_DATA.label: HAZARD
CASES_DATA.desc: Trench hazard! Estimate how many kilometers deep the Mariana Trench goes. (about 11 km) More than 2 km off = -500 pts.
CASES_DATA.fact: The Mariana Trench is almost 11,000 m deep. Drop Mount Everest in and its peak would still be more than 2 km underwater.

CASES_DATA.label: HAZARD
CASES_DATA.desc: Core meltdown! Estimate the temperature of Earth's inner core in °C. (about 5,200 °C) Not within 1,000 °C = -1,000 pts.
CASES_DATA.fact: The inner core is a solid ball of iron and nickel about as hot as the surface of the Sun. Huge pressure keeps it solid.

CASES_DATA.label: HAZARD
CASES_DATA.desc: Greenhouse hazard! Estimate the amount of CO₂ in the air in 2025, in parts per million. (about 427 ppm) Not within 25 ppm = -1,000 pts.
CASES_DATA.fact: NOAA data show CO₂ has risen every year since 1959. Before the Industrial Revolution it was about 280 ppm.

CASES_DATA.label: HAZARD
CASES_DATA.desc: Supervolcano hazard! Estimate how long ago Earth formed. (about 4.6 billion years) Not within half a billion years = -2,000 pts.
CASES_DATA.fact: Meteorites and Moon rocks show Earth formed about 4.6 billion years ago from a spinning cloud of gas and dust.

CASES_DATA.label: BONUS
CASES_DATA.desc: Rock Hound! Name the 3 main types of rock. (+500 pts)
CASES_DATA.fact: Igneous (cooled from magma or lava), sedimentary (cemented sediment), and metamorphic (changed by heat and pressure).

CASES_DATA.label: BONUS
CASES_DATA.desc: Storm Spotter! What is the difference between a tornado WATCH and a tornado WARNING? (+500 pts)
CASES_DATA.fact: A watch means conditions are right for tornadoes, so be ready. A warning means a tornado has been spotted or shown on radar, so take shelter now.

CASES_DATA.label: BONUS
CASES_DATA.desc: Quake Ready! What 3 actions protect you when the shaking starts? (+500 pts)
CASES_DATA.fact: Drop, Cover, and Hold On. Get low, get under something sturdy, and hang on until the shaking stops.

CASES_DATA.label: BONUS
CASES_DATA.desc: Star Gazer! Name the 4 rocky inner planets in order from the Sun. (+500 pts)
CASES_DATA.fact: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars. These terrestrial planets are small and rocky; the outer four are gas and ice giants.
